messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Sabah (Food & Beverage).", "The register lists 3 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (98.86%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 4,419,464 and the after-tax profit was RM 178,923.", "The record lists 6 court cases (6 as defendant). 2 are marked pending."], "menu": {"case": {"fact": "In CASE-2022-9003, the company is the defendant in a winding-up petition (Pending, claim RM 355,900).", "next_check": "Check the latest docket entry for CASE-2022-9003."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was RM 220,184.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 2,132,519.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "filings": {"fact": "FY2023 is missing between FY2022 and FY2024.", "next_check": "Obtain comparable filings before interpreting the change in revenue."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 1.90×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was 4.0%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 2017-11-20.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}}}
